Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results and prematurely concluded that Arnold IV of Looz was Louis IV’s father (and thus Joan’s paternal grandfather). This conflated Joan’s husband (Arnold IV of Loon/Looz) with her grandfather and ignored contradictory evidence on the same results page (e.g., FamilySearch and WikiTree indicating Louis III as Louis IV’s father). The Planner relied on an erroneous snippet without verification, failed to cross-check multiple credible sources, and overlooked timeline inconsistencies (Louis IV’s father dying on the Third Crusade aligns with Louis III, not Arnold IV of Looz).
